rows.translation_en:
About half of all attack spells are Fire spells.
Fire Skill's true value lies in dealing
large amounts of damage through magic.
Naturally, those gifted in Fire Skill
will tend to specialize
in attack spells.

rows.translation_en:
This is the ability
to use all sorts of spells effectively.

rows.translation_en:
Even if you obtain a scroll,
you cannot use its spell until your Skill
meets the learning requirements.
And even the same spell
can vary so wildly with the caster's Skill
that it hardly seems like the same spell at all.

rows.translation_en:
Water Skill is the power to cherish life.
It forms the foundation for learning
spells that restore your allies' HP.
Including at least one person
with high Water Skill in the party
is a basic rule for surviving battles.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en:
If you keep uniting with deities of the same line
for generation after generation, the blood grows
more concentrated and its traits become clearer.
It's a great way
to raise your fighting strength quickly
and dramatically... But...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
It's a double-edged sword that also makes
frail children more likely to be born.
Everything in moderation... Or perhaps
in for a penny, in for a pound... Hey, now!
The decision is yours, %$.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
She's currently heaven's youngest deity,
and also its most powerful!!
After thousands of years of division,
she used some outrageously forceful methods
to bring all of heaven together with a bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en: And she's quite beautiful too!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
That means she has plenty of enemies,
but I'm absolutely on her side.
Go! Go! Hiruko!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

Hiruko is explicitly female in the glossary; the cheer retains her name.

rows.translation_en:
Actually, my hairstyle
is copied from Hiruko...
When people say we look alike,
I'm a little embarrassed,
but it still makes me happy!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Itsuka refers to herself by name; English uses I in this row.

rows.translation_en:
Whether to favor numbers or quality in the clan...
In other words, how many Offering Points
to save before Divine Union is the difficult question.
Perhaps five to seven times
over two years is a safe balance...
I don't really know! Ha ha!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.
Five to seven unions over two years is uncertain character advice, not a verified optimum.

rows.translation_en:
When certain conditions are met,
you can enshrine the spirit of a deceased
family member as a deity.
This new deity
is called a clan deity.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Through Divine Union, the deceased's blood
will live again and again, giving the %$ clan
strength that lasts forever.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en:
Heaven's second most powerful deity,
after Hiruko.
Hiruko's adoptive parent and guardian.
And, of course, the supreme leader
who ruled heaven before Hiruko!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The one who rescued you from Mount Oe, %$,
and arranged all sorts of help for you
was actually Yuko Taishoten.
Heaven's wonderfully kind mother!!
Though asking her age
might be a little frightening...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en:
During a hunt, watch HP constantly,
both in battle and while moving.
Aim to keep it above seventy percent of maximum.
If the Health warning appears,
restore HP immediately.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Half HP is out of the question!!
Health will drain before your eyes
like water from a bucket with no bottom.
Until you've learned this world's
rules and ways, don't go running
all over the place with the X button.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
I've also added an explanation
about "○○."
Please read it when you have a moment!!

rows.translation_en:
"Plan your year on New Year's Day!!"
This is a perfect opportunity. Write down
your goals for the year
and stick them somewhere you'll see them.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en:
When making plans, weigh the present, a month ahead,
and a year ahead in roughly
a three-to-two-to-one ratio.
That's about the right balance
between doing what's best right now
and thinking far into the future.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en: Probably. Ha ha!

rows.translation_en:
Predict where prices for rice, wheat, and other goods
will be in six months, and invest in likely risers.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If the price six months later is higher
than when you bought,
the difference is a big, beautiful profit!
Well, buy things near their lowest price
without stretching your finances.
That's the most basic rule of all.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Incidentally, you can buy only one type of commodity a month.
Please don't get carried away
and ruin the family fortune.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Unlike ordinary medicine, herbal remedies
are remarkable medicines that restore Health.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
But each person can take them only once a month.
And the prices exploit people's vulnerability.
They're outrageous!
Even their names
sound terribly suspicious. If you can manage
without them, that's best of all.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
As people and shops return to the capital,
money flows in from across the country.
Then, drawn by that golden gleam,
white-faced "Kyoto beauties born out in the provinces"
come flocking in from everywhere too!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en: For better or worse, that's Kyoto!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The Print Shop sells portraits
of those lovely ladies as "beauty prints"
to connoisseurs.
Rumor has it... there are some duds
mixed in, but apparently that only
fires up collectors even more...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
A mysterious shop that preserves
your family's appearance at this very moment forever,
so you can look at it whenever you like.
The prices are reasonable, so for New Year's, birthdays,
or commemorating a mighty enemy's defeat...
Please give it a try on occasions like those.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The Portrait Studio has just one drawback:
there's a limit to how many pictures it can keep.
Only thirty!!
For everyone in the %@ clan,
I wish at least your number of memories
could be greater than other people's...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Every sword Kenpuku forges
is a one-of-a-kind custom creation.
Of course, you can name it too.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
And the more you use it,
the sharper it supposedly gets!!
...Or so the rumors may or may not say.
Apparently they're rather expensive, but why not try?
When you have some money to spare,
perhaps you could place an order.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The Commerce sector includes weapon, armor,
accessory, and general goods shops.
At the changing of the seasons,
they often hold big sales
and replace their stock.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
As rebuilding progresses, the selection improves.
You'll have more chances to obtain rare weapons,
armor, accessories, items, and so on.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Frankly, this sector isn't a matter
of life and death. You can manage
perfectly well without it...
But people need a little room to breathe,
or rather, now and then
you have to let loose and relax!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Why not invest as casually
as giving yourself a treat when something nice happens?
You can gaze at family photos
and grow sentimental, then grin over beauty prints.
I think there's a certain charm
to that way of spending your time.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
By investing money,
you can rebuild the capital
that Shutendoji and the oni destroyed.
As life returns to the city,
various shops will naturally open
and more kinds of goods will be traded.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Continued investment will indirectly
give the %@ clan powerful support
in fulfilling its vow.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
The Commodity Broker is a financial service
that's quite handy to have around.
If you're the sort to say,
"Money's money, damn it,
no matter how you get it!!" then it's perfect for you.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Next is the Herbalist.
They say healing is a benevolent art,
and medicine is insurance against misfortune.
It's an important shop that teaches you
even health and life can, to some extent,
be bought with money.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.
The claim about buying health is commentary on the fictional herbalist, not real medical advice.

rows.translation_en:
Public Works reflects the capital's overall strength!!
To develop this sector, you'll also need
to invest in the other three.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Investment in Religion pays for the repair
and construction of shrines, temples, and the like.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
As religious facilities grow grander,
the people's faith deepens
and the gods are delighted.
It's odd to call it a thank-you gift,
but the Offering Points needed for Divine Union
fall just a tiny bit.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When particular conditions are met,
religious monuments may be built
or festivals held.
On special occasions like those,
I think the gods will stop being stingy
and give those point costs a great big cut!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Each class has up to four secret arts:
surefire techniques that develop naturally
when Spirit, Skill, and Body are all strong enough.
Incidentally, their names preserve
the name of whoever devised them,
something like "Itsuka Radish Chop."
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.
Itsuka's name remains part of the hypothetical secret art title.

rows.translation_en:
First, one person chooses
an attack spell others can also use
and declares a combined spell!!
The second and third people
choose the same spell on their own turns!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
When the person who began the combined spell
gets their next turn,
bang! The combined spell is complete!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
To make it more effective,
increase the total number of participants.
And start it with whoever has the highest Skill
in the attribute needed to learn that spell.
Don't forget those two things!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.
The relevant Skill attribute, not MP, determines the recommended initiator.

rows.translation_en:
You can select and use secret arts
from Skills in battle.
Unlike spells, secret arts push
your own body to its limits. Naturally,
some of them seriously damage your Health!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

rows.translation_en:
So relying on secret arts alone
is far too dangerous!! Use them too much
and you'll shorten your life...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Secret arts pass to one child alone.
You can teach an art to only one
of your own children of the same class
by personally training them.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Anyone who masters a secret art should
have a successor and train them as soon as possible,
so that hard-earned technique isn't lost.
If inheritance should fail,
the art will be lost until someone appears
whose Spirit, Skill, and Body meet its requirements again.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If a parent and child in the party
have mastered the same offensive secret art,
they can combine that art.
It's powerful enough with one user,
but together, they can finish an enemy in a single blow!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Combining it across three generations,
parent, child, and grandchild, is even more amazing.
But please, watch everyone's Health carefully.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Time passes during battle too.
...Though it advances only after
a certain number of people have acted.
So there's absolutely no need
to rush your orders.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If anything, to save time, think carefully
about how to win in fewer moves,
then give concise, stylish orders.
"Open with a combined Karanka,
then finish in eight moves!! Got it!?"
Something like that, for example...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
While walking through a cave or dungeon,
eight flames at the upper left of the screen
represent the time available for one month.
As time passes,
they go out one by one.
When they're all gone, the month ends.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
Decide whether to continue hunting or return to Kyoto
after checking Health Changes if You Continue
and the Schedule.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
A sortie, rest, or Divine Union
uses up one month.
There are twelve months in a year, of course.
During an adventure, incidentally,
a month takes about fifteen to twenty minutes
of real time on average.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
While a window is open,
time stops completely,
even while traveling.
If the phone suddenly rings or nature calls,
remember this before you panic or have an accident.
Please put it to good use.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
If you avoid enemies, a month lasts
about four real minutes. That's enough
to cover quite a distance.
Watch HP and Health,
and run with X. Reaching the deepest parts
of a dungeon needn't be a dream!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.
review_notes: Source trailing fragments and line-break counts retained.

rows.translation_en:
...Perhaps? I've never been on a sortie,
so how would I possibly know
all that? Ha ha!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, final body entries. Previous entries 238-239 and the alternate help table examined. Spell attributes, deities, facilities, investment, secret arts, and time. Uncertain advice remains explicitly uncertain.

Itsuka undercuts her own travel-time advice in this final row.

@This class fights with bare hands and feet.
Speed and sheer number of attacks are its strengths.
